status: Accepted clean physical Android Wikipedia memory cohort; physical startup, title search and maps have no accepted result in this receipt.
identityVerification: Installed APK and on-device archive byte hashes were observed and matched frozen inputs; private identities.json is linked by digest only. Its obsolete profile-preservation policy does not govern this cohort.

statePolicy.cohort: Fresh-profile, controlled-appearance; not untouched product defaults or proven identical computed typography.
statePolicy.reset: Owner authorized clearing only the two named Kiwix packages; both resets succeeded. Unrelated apps/shared archive files were not cleared.
statePolicy.preparation: Real Wikipedia archive index -> actual Animal link, article top.
statePolicy.visualBoundary: Actual article heading/montage/classification landmarks admitted before and after each block. Similar landmark vertical positions do not prove equal chrome, viewport or computed typography.

memoryScope.metric: Sum of dumpsys meminfo TOTAL PSS for every exclusively attributed selected main and owned renderer process, including reported graphics mtrack.
memoryScope.swap: Swap PSS reported separately, never added to resident PSS.
memoryScope.excluded: Shared/unassigned system, GPU and display services; not unrestricted whole-system memory.
memoryScope.processAttribution: Selected PID/startTicks and parsed Activity Manager ProcessRecord.packageList retained from initial and every before/after observation. All selected processes exclusively belong to the benchmark package.
memoryScope.generationSource: /proc/PID/stat startTicks parsed by reviewed collector; PID alone is not process identity.
memoryScope.measurementBoundary: Per-process dumpsys acquisition is sequential, not one simultaneous whole-system snapshot.
memoryScope.notPooled: Physical dumpsys TOTAL PSS is not pooled with emulator smaps_rollup PSS or earlier preserved-profile/warm observations.

workload.timestampScope: Host monotonic seconds; startedMonotonic begins ownership/acquisition and monotonic marks completed observation. These are not article latency measures.
workload.retention: All 32 accepted samples retained. First sample is lower than the remaining three in EVERY block for BOTH apps; no causal explanation or outlier pruning.

wiki.conclusion: Ours uses 4.11% more attributed PSS; all four adjacent paired-block signs are unfavorable. This is a bounded workload comparison, not proof across archives/devices.

reviewBoundaries.memoryAdmission: ReviewComparisonInstrumentation independently accepted clean eight-block memory cohort and reviewed collector snapshot ABF6.

reviewBoundaries.publicSanitization: Only selected benchmark PID generations/package lists, numeric metrics/times and explicit public summaries exported. No raw ownership dumps, command argv, device serial, username, status bars or device IDs.
reviewBoundaries.pendingPhysicalMeasurements: Startup, title-search and rendered-map physical comparisons require independently admitted evidence; no results inferred from calibration/plans/emulator data.
reviewBoundaries.audioAndOtherDevices: No audio/VoiceOver results; no iPhone comparison completed by this cohort.
